decision_conditions: <p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the commencement of works hereby approved, full details of the permeable driveway (including finished level section drawings) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The permeable driveway hereby approved shall use a no dig/tree-friendly design.&nbsp;</p>

The window(s) and openings in the flank elevation(s) of the proposed development facing towards 43 Uxbridge Road shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

The roof area of the rear extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

None of the existing trees on the site shall be lopped, topped, felled or uprooted, other than the trees as shown to be removed in the approved plans, without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping which is approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard 3998 (Tree Work).
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Single and two storey front extension; single storey rear extension; rear dormer; installation of rooflights in front and side roof slopes; landscaping; bin and cycle stores; external alterations
